events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album, 'Definitely Maybe', on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe impact
angles.copy: Twenty-two years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music forever. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock memories
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the mud, the music, and the magic. What's the first band you think of when you hear 'Woodstock'?

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing anniversary
events.blurb: August 16th marks the anniversary of the death of rock and roll icon Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Tribute to Elvis
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll. Elvis Presley left us on this day, but his music lives on. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur would have been 55
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and passed away six days later on September 13th. He would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, a voice that defined a generation, who would have been 55. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix would have been 84
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970. He would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road iconic cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most iconic of all time. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! What's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite tune featuring his iconic vocals?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic album 'Imagine' in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine', a song that still resonates globally. What does this timeless anthem mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod dropped and changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: October 9th marks the birthday of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His vision and music continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your standout track?
